findings.finding: Q3 2026 had no US hurricane landfall (Isaias, landfall 2026-10-09, is described as the first US hurricane since 2024, i.e. a Q4 event), so RLI's hurricane-driven E&S property cat load should be light like Q2 2026 (~$10m total cat, 'light') and benign Q3 2025 ($0.83 operating EPS vs $0.70); against a ~$0.50-0.54 consensus (high estimate $0.62) that appears to embed a ~$0.25-0.30/share Q3 cat load, operating EPS in the $0.75-0.90 area would be a ~40-60% beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 benign-season beat $0.83 vs $0.70 (+19%): +2.78%. Q2 2026 beat $0.83 vs $0.72: +3.68%. Q1 2026 $0.83 vs ~$0.79: -3.80. Large earnings beats here buy low single digits.

findings.why_not_priced: Consensus across Yahoo (8 analysts), MarketBeat and Earnings Whispers still sits at $0.50-0.54, well below the $0.83 run-rate of the last three reported quarters; if the street had marked Q3 to the quiet season the bar would be near $0.75-0.80.
